2. The appellants have been convicted and sentenced in Sessions Trial No. 303/2019, for the offence under Sections 498A/34, 304-B/34 and 302/34 of IPC and under Section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

They have been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for life and fine amount of Rs.10,000/-
3.

2. The appellants have been convicted and sentenced in Sessions Trial No. 303/2019, for the offence under Sections 498A/34, 304-B/34 and 302/34 of IPC and under Section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
4. Opportunity was given to the State to oppose the bail, which the State availed and opposed.
5. Prayer for bail of this appellant was earlier rejected vide order dated 09.07.2024.
